literal: He who says that which the people of the world say exists does not exist, will be considered as a ghost on the earth.
translation: He who denies the existence of what the people of the world accept as real will be regarded as a demon on this earth.
modern: உலக மக்கள் உண்டு என்று ஒப்புக்கொள்ளும் ஒன்றை இல்லை என்று கூறுபவன், இவ்வுலகில் ஒரு பேயாகக் கருதப்படுவான்.
explanation: This couplet defines the ultimate foolishness of denying common consensus and established truths. When the collective wisdom of the world agrees that something exists or is true, a person who stubbornly denies it isolates himself from humanity. The poet uses the word 'அலகை' (ghost or demon) to describe such a denier, indicating that they are no longer considered part of human society. By refusing to align with the shared reality of the world, they walk among living humans like an alien, disembodied spirit.
